summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026 regarding an Exchange Agreement with an investor. The company partitioned a $988,000 promissory note from an existing $3.6M note and exchanged it for 1,300,000 shares of common stock, with no cash consideration. The exchange is subject to a 19.9% beneficial ownership limitation, potentially requiring tranched issuance. This debt-to-equity conversion reduces leverage but may dilute existing shareholders. What to watch: impact on share count and potential further exchanges from the remaining Original Note.
